# homebrew-tap

> This repository is a read-only mirror of <https://git.kingepic84.page/kingepic84/homebrew-tap>.
> Issues and changes are handled there; you can sign in with your GitHub account.

Homebrew tap for [imux](https://imux.cc).

```sh
brew install kingepic84/tap/imux
```

The formula installs the release binary. It is regenerated from the latest imux release, so
the version and checksums here always match a published release.
